timeout.description: Global timeout in seconds for signaling messages and link maintenance.

log_file_path.description: Absolute path to the log file. Ensure the osmocom user has write permissions.

log_color.description: Enable ANSI color codes in terminal output.

log_line_prefix.description: Custom prefix for each log line (e.g., subsystem tag). Leave empty to use defaults.

local_spc.description: Local Signaling Point Code (SPC) for this STP. Must be unique in the network.

local_spc_mask.description: Mask for the local SPC. Often 0xFF for 8-bit SPCs, 0x3FFF for 14-bit.

point_to_point.description: If true: point-to-point links only. If false: point-to-multipoint (multiple DPCs per linkset).

link_sets.description: List of SS7 link sets (collections of links with shared routing context and destination points).

id.description: Unique numeric ID for this linkset (1–255).

routing_context.description: Routing context (RC). Required in SCCP for multi-homed STPs. 0 = default.

dest_points.description: List of destination SPCs served by this linkset.

links.description: List of signaling links (physical or virtual) in this linkset.

id.description: Unique link ID within the linkset.

local_ip.description: Local IP address for this link (e.g., STP server interface).

local_port.description: Local UDP/TCP port. Use 3000–3999 for M3UA, 2905 for M2UA, etc.

remote_ip.description: Remote peer IP (e.g., MSC, BSC, or another STP).

remote_port.description: Remote port (typically matches local_port on peer).

priority.description: Link priority (higher = primary). Used for load balancing and failover.

tcp_fallback.description: Enable TCP fallback for SCTP (not recommended for SS7 interoperability).

h248_enabled.description: Enable H.248/Megaco media gateway control support (rarely needed for pure STP).

stats_enabled.description: Enable real-time statistics collection (MTP3/SCCP message counters).

stats_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between statistics dumps to log.

stats_file.description: Optional path to write periodic stats in JSON format.

ctrl_port.description: TCP port for the control interface (used by osmo-stp-ctrl for runtime config and monitoring).

ctrl_bind.description: Bind address for the control interface. Use '0.0.0.0' only if secure access is guaranteed.

ipa_unit_id.description: IPA unit ID (used for BTS identification in OsmoBTS integration).

ipa_clock_id.description: IPA clock identifier: 0x21=33 (E1), 0x20=32 (PCM), per IPA spec.

nat_rules_enabled.description: Enable NAT-aware routing rules (advanced use; rarely needed).
